output.content: I am looking at the validation logs from last week and noticed we are running the model accuracy checks against a hardcoded threshold in the config file. The team transition happened three months ago, and the original KPI definition document is not in the shared drive anymore. I asked the previous lead, but they had already left. So right now, the pipeline just compares the output to that static number. I do not see any dynamic baseline or historical comparison being calculated during the nightly runs. The metrics are simply passed or failed based on that single value. I am not sure where the original definitions went, but they are not accessible to me today.
